messages:
andre: heads-up — planning the quant-kernel swap for the night window (00:30 UTC). i want to add a short grace window so in-flight batching jobs don't get killed mid-eviction.
jamie: +1. what duration were you thinking?
sam: is this the matmul_v2 -> matmul_v3 swap? any ABI changes to be worried about?
andre: yes matmul_v3, no ABI bump, but there were a couple of edge-case fp16 regressions in staging perf tests. not service-breaking but could spike tail latency.
lia: from oncall perspective: if we allow a grace window, we need a clear fallback policy and a metric guard (error% or p50/p99 delta).
marta: suggest 10m grace window after deploybot issues the swap, and a pin_ttl of 2h for safety so we can roll back without churn.
jamie: 10m sounds reasonable. deploy-bot currently drains pods immediately which kills any long KV cache ops. need to patch deploy-bot to wait + drain.
sam: i can push a tiny change to deploy-bot to add a `grace_seconds` param. quick config snippet:```yaml
deploy:
  swap_target: matmul_v3
  grace_seconds: 600
  pin_ttl_seconds: 7200
  rollback_on_error_pct: 0.5
```
andre: perfect. can deploybot emit events so we know when the grace starts/ends? we want a handoff message in the channel.
deploy-bot: scheduled swap for matmul_v3 at 00:30 UTC. grace_seconds=600, pin_ttl_seconds=7200. will post progress updates. :gear:
lia: add metric guards: if error_rate > 0.5% OR p99 latency increases > 20% within first 15m, auto rollback. also notify pager after rollback.
marta: agree. also add a temporary smoke eval set (short prompt suite) run at +5m and +12m after swap — fail -> rollback.
jamie: i'll add the smoke set and wire the eval runner to the rollback webhook. sam, can you push the deploy-bot PR now so we can stage it for a midday dry-run?
sam: pushing in 10. PR: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/4123 — change is tiny, unit tests included.
andre: nice. release notes: short blurb under "runtime changes" + callout about the grace window and rollback thresholds. also mention the pin_ttl to operations. lia, can you draft?
lia: will do. will include exact metrics and the rollback playbook steps.
marta: ops checklist for rollforward: 1) preflight smoke run 2) enable grace window 3) monitor evals and telemetry 4) confirm pin_ttl set 5) if triggered, run rollback playbook.
andre: decision: proceed with night window, grace_seconds=600, pin_ttl_seconds=7200, rollback_on_error_pct=0.5, smoke evals at +5m/+12m. sam to merge deploy-bot PR and coordinate dry-run. jamie will prepare rollout script. lia on release notes.
jamie: i'll also add a log marker for mem/cpu pressure so we can correlate.
sam: merged PR -> main and queued dry-run in staging at 17:10 UTC. deploy-bot will post staging progress.
deploy-bot: staging swap executed. grace window started (600s). smoke eval pass at +5m: all green. :white_check_mark:
andre: thanks all. i'll post the short release note snippet in product channel and pin the ops checklist. if anything anomalous during night window, tag #eng-oncall and @lia immediately. :rotating_light:
lia: copy that. will be watching.
marta: leaving a reminder to unset the pin after 2h if everything is healthy, otherwise we keep it until rollback completes.
jamie: small follow-up — can we add a short TTL warning 15m before pin expiry so owners can extend if needed? low effort.
and re: later: we'll revisit default grace window for future kernel swaps.
andre: noted. action items summarized in the PR and i'll create a follow-up ticket for defaulting grace_seconds. thanks everyone.
